svg.title: Two sources: Sources in phase (0 degrees)
svg.desc: Circular solid wavefronts are crests and dashed wavefronts are troughs. Blue solid curves are antinodal loci; orange dashed curves are nodal loci. The source separation is three wavelengths. The perpendicular bisector swaps between an antinodal and a nodal line when the second source phase reverses.
svg.text: Two sources: Sources in phase (0 degrees)
Solid thin rings: crests Dashed thin rings: troughs
Ideal review model: equal frequency; equal received amplitudes.
